full_judgment: 31. Reverting back to the cases referred to by Mr. Quasem. The case of Surat Sardar, 49 DLR (AD) 99, as referred to by Mr. Quasem, is all about cause of action of suits which is far removed from the basic point mooted here in this case. Arfan Ali Sheikh's case, 14 DLR 791, is concerned with nature of tenancy vis-a vis presumption of knowledge of the pre-emptor and estoppels in pre-emption. In Elias Shah's case, 17 DLR 277, it is held by a Division Bench of the then High Court of East Pakistan that without assessment of compensation of property the same cannot vest in the Provincial Government and Jalil Ahmed's case reported in 19 DLR 106, another Division Bench of the then High Court of East Pakistan ruled that notification dated 9-5-1956 did not exempt waqfs from acquisition. The cases sought to be relied upon by Mr. Quasem are plainly distinguishable from the facts of the instant case and are of no avail to him.
